snippet.title: Graphite | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Graphite now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3080560/Graphite/ 

Unleash your creativity as the drawings of a kid spring to life, engaging in epic battles on the dynamic timeline of this thrilling Roguelike RPG, where the characters are unaware they exist within the bounds of imagination!
